Miura Global Management Stake in Facebook (FB) Has Trimmed as Market Value Declined; Lennox Intl (LII) Holder Eaton Vance Management Has Boosted Its Position
May 24, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Pasco Alfaro / Richard Tumure decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 37.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Miura Global Management Llc sold 75,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund run by Pasco Alfaro / Richard Tumure held 125,000 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $22.06 million, down from 200,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Miura Global Management Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $538.31 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.50% or $0.931 during the last trading session, reaching $185.969. About 5.72 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
